title: narcissus poeticus var. poetarum
intro: Narcissus poeticus var. poetarum, commonly known as the Pheasant's Eye or Poet's Narcissus, is a bulbous perennial plant of the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its unique, drooping white flowers with a distinctive red center, often associated with the folklore of the Greek myth of Narcissus. The Pheasant's Eye has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections and wounds. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, which have been shown to have analgesic, antispasmodic, and antiviral effects, as well as its potential to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity.
